design: Tool-free battery swap on the battery-on-cap backpack (D-037, qilinxiaoxiang/microduck_rl 8bce48af): an opening in the roof and the rear rounded top corner straight above the battery (frame and cap, across the cap seam; the cradle roof tab goes), closed by a printed hatch that restores the roof and the rounded corner flush (top z 43, back x -75.55). The cap's rounded corner overhangs the battery's rear 2 mm, so the hatch carries that corner. The hatch has two fixed front tabs under the frame roof edge (the hinge), a back flap 28 x 19 x 1.2 mm on the cap's back face whose 1.2 mm bump snaps into a slot through the cap back wall (released by pulling the flap's lower edge out about 1.3 mm, root strain 0.77 %), a wedge that holds the battery down 0.3 mm above its top, and lead notches open to the rear so neither battery lead is unplugged to open it. The two retainer bars stay screwed and are no longer removed; the switch, DFR1202 and box outline are unchanged. All three parts print in Orange.

approved.history: 2026-11-01: concept sheet concept/concept-sheet.png (top opening, hatch lying 1.6 mm above the roof with fixed front tabs and one PLA side snap, bars fixed, pull tab). Shawn asked what the pull tab is (Kapton tape on each battery, 0.05 mm, fits the 0.3 mm play), then 'have a try'. CAD found the cap's rear rounded top corner overhanging the battery by about 2 mm and only 12 % of the side-snap hook under the roof, so the hatch now includes the corner (flush, no growth) and the snap moved to a back flap (renders/review-sheet.png). Shawn approved this revision with the last quote, and the colour: all Orange. 2026-11-01 evening: V1.40 printed and failed three ways (XT30 does not pass the 6 mm notches, the flap bump slides out of its slot on a pull-back, the wedge holds nothing). V2 (inside hooks, then leaf springs and tongues) rejected by Shawn as PLA flexures on a moving robot; V3 as in design_v3, sheet renders-v2/review-sheet.png, released as V1.41.

design_v3: V3 (release V1.41, 2026-11-01), after the V1.40 bench test: the hatch keeps the V1.40 outside flap (lift) and front lips (1.0 mm under the frame roof edge); two solid ear stubs (1.55 x 4 x 2.35 mm, |y| 15.5..19.5; Shawn: "有必要做这么长吗 看起来很脆弱") on the plate sit in two pockets cut in the cap roof (x -70.0..-68.15, |y| 15.9..19.7) and stop pull-back after 0.15 mm; a solid block (x -73..-63, y 5..13) hangs 0.3 mm above the battery top, foam tape as the fallback; one lead window x -72..-63.4, y -14.65..3.0, open to the rear top above z 38.64, passes the XT30 (10.2 x 5.2) and the JST-XH. No leaf springs, tongues or inside hooks. Cap: V1.40 cut and flap slot plus the two ear pockets. Frame: V1.40, not reprinted.
